newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar moves narrowly in late PM.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar moves narrowly in late PM.

text.p: White sugar futures showed little movement during late afternoon trading although the turnover was boosted to 4,510 lots as players rolled out of the near August position ahead of its expiry later this month.
August ended $0.10 down from Friday with last business at $319.10 a tonne.
Traders said there was very little going on in physicals to give fresh direction to the market and technically the it was finely poised while trading around the pivotal $320 a tonne level.
Paris 45 ICUMSA ended with August $0.60 down at $318.70 in a turnover of 940 lots while 100 ICUMSA ended with October down $0.50 a tonne at $290.00 in a tunover of 10 lots.
